items.statement: Revenue rose 130.4% year on year to Rs 360.7 crore.
items.quote: So, revenue from the operation is at INR360.7 crores in Q1 FY27 as against INR156.6 crores in Q1 FY26, which resulted 130.4% increase in revenue.

items.statement: PAT rose 364.5% year on year to Rs 50.2 crore.
items.quote: Profit after tax was at INR50.2 crores in Q1 FY27 as against INR10.8 crores in Q1 FY26, which is 364.5% increase

items.statement: Working capital days fell to 59 from 172 for FY26.
items.quote: When it comes to the working capital days, we have achieved 59 days compared to the 172 days during the FY26 entire year,

items.statement: Gross margin fell to 45.61% from 47.65% a year ago because of revenue mix.
items.quote: Gross margins we achieved as 45.61% in this quarter, as compared to the last year 47.65%. This is due to revenue mix,

items.statement: Management reiterated 80% revenue growth for FY27 with a 24% plus-minus 100 bps EBITDA margin.
items.quote: I would like to reiterate our confidence in achieving the guidance given earlier at 80% revenue growth for the current fiscal year with an EBITDA margin of 24% plus-minus 100 basis points,

items.statement: Aerospace and defence revenue is expected to double this fiscal year.
items.quote: We expect to double our revenues in aerospace and defense segment during the current fiscal year,

items.statement: The company expects a closing order book of Rs 5,000 crore by the end of FY27.
items.quote: we expect a robust closing order book of INR5,000 crores by end of this fiscal year, providing a strong revenue visibility.

items.statement: The second half is expected to be stronger than the first across segments.
items.quote: Second half would be even stronger than the first half in all these segments that we are talking about, including the product division.

items.statement: Nuclear order execution will start in the second half of this year and keep growing.
items.quote: Second half of this year, the execution will commence, and it will continue to grow from there on.

items.statement: In 3-4 years aerospace could reach Rs 600-700 crore and products over Rs 1,000 crore.
items.quote: No, no, aerospace, probably, you're looking at INR600 crores, INR700 crores, and products should cross more than INR1,000 crores.

items.statement: All business verticals show strong momentum with a healthy pipeline.
items.quote: We continue to see strong momentum across all our business verticals, supported by favorable industry tailwinds and a healthy pipeline of opportunities.

items.statement: MNC aerospace customers show strong demand for already-qualified products.
items.quote: Our MNC aerospace business continues to demonstrate phenomenal growth potential, with significant demand from existing customers for products that have already been qualified.

items.statement: Completed aerospace first articles are converting into 10-15 times the volumes.
items.quote: first articles whatever we completed, we are getting at least 10 to 15 times of the volumes in the aerospace sector.

items.statement: Interest cost is expected to come down quarter on quarter.
items.quote: So, it would come down moving forward on a quarter-on-quarter basis, I guess.

items.statement: EBITDA margin was 23.54% against the 24% annual guidance, up from 20.11% last quarter.
items.quote: which is actually 23.54% we achieved as against yearly guidance of 24% we have given, and last quarter EBITDA margins was at 20.11%,

items.statement: Improving EBITDA margin remains a priority as revenue scales.
items.quote: Improving EBITDA margins also remains a key priority as we scale our revenues.

items.statement: About Rs 500 crore of capex is needed across this year and next.
items.quote: this requires almost INR500 crores of capex for this year and also next year put together,

items.statement: Only Rs 30-35 crore was spent in Q1, though Rs 80 crore was capitalised.
items.quote: For quarter 1, we might have spent around INR30 crores -INR35 crores only capex, but overall INR80 crores which is capitalized.

items.statement: Fuel cell capacity expansion is on track: Phase 1 done, Phase 2 by September-October 2026.
items.quote: Our capacity augmentation plan for fuel cells being implemented in three phases remains on track, with Phase 1 already commissioned, Phase 2 to be commissioned by September-October of this year,

items.statement: The multifold Phase 3 expansion will be commissioned by March 2027, with ramp-up from April.
items.quote: It's going to be commissioning by March '27, the multifold expansion plan, and then we move on to the ramp-up plan afterwards from April onwards.

items.statement: A dedicated facility is being set up for data centre infrastructure products.
items.quote: To support this opportunity, we are also setting up a dedicated facility for data center infrastructure solutions.

items.statement: The order book stood at Rs 5,143 crore at quarter end, with Rs 800 crore more received on the call day.
items.quote: Our closing order book by end of this quarter already stands at INR5,143 crores, and we have received additional INR800 crores of orders today.

items.statement: Clean energy received record order inflows in the quarter.
items.quote: We received record order inflows during the quarter, further strengthening our already robust order book and providing strong visibility for growth going forward.

items.statement: Another Rs 130-140 crore of nuclear refurbishment orders is expected this quarter.
items.quote: We're expecting another INR130 crores-INR140 crores of orders coming in in this quarter.

items.statement: Net of investments and cash, debt is only about Rs 20-30 crore.
items.quote: So, literally, there is no debt in the company except some INR20 crores -30 crores after adjusting the cash balances whatever we have.

items.statement: Operating cash flow was Rs 247.69 crore against Rs 191.66 crore last year.
items.quote: And cash flow from operations is at INR247.69 crores in this quarter as against INR191.66 crores in the last year.

items.statement: Working capital is at 59-60 days and should stay below 100 days for the year.
items.quote: we'll be sustaining it, we are at 59-60 days right now, but we'll be below 100 days for the year,

items.statement: The company has entered data centre infrastructure solutions.
items.quote: we have entered the data center infrastructure solutions segment, where we see significant growth potential.

items.statement: Volume orders are expected for actuator assemblies for LCA Tejas Mark-1A.
items.quote: In the domestic defense segment, we are anticipating volume orders for actuator assemblies for LCA Tejas Mark-1A,

items.statement: Ball screws are doing well with many export orders.
items.quote: We are doing extremely well in ball screws where we have lot of export orders as well,

items.statement: India's 100 GW nuclear target by 2047 is a substantial long-term opportunity.
items.quote: With the Government of India targeting 100 gigawatts of nuclear power capacity by 2047, we believe the long-term opportunity for the company in this sector is substantial.

items.statement: Civil nuclear has become a steadier, less cyclical business.
items.quote: We believe civil nuclear vertical has transitioned to a more consistent and sustainable growth trajectory with substantially reduced cyclicality compared to the past.

items.statement: Tenders for four 700 MW Mahi Banswara reactors have been floated.
items.quote: the tenders have already been floated for these four projects, four 700-megawatt reactors.

items.statement: Execution of new orders depends on how quickly expansion plans are implemented.
items.quote: it all depends on how soon we can implement our expansion plan and then take it forward.

items.statement: Mahi Banswara orders may only come in the next financial year.
items.quote: So, we're already having our plate full in terms of orders, so probably these orders might come in in the next financial year.

items.statement: positive

items.statement: Gross margin improved to 46.8% from 45.5% in the prior quarter on a better product mix.
items.quote: our gross margins improved to 46.8% from 45.5% in the previous quarter, mainly because of a better product revenue mix.

items.statement: Working capital days fell to 50 at September 2026 from 172 at March 2026.
items.quote: our working capital days came down to 50 as of September 2026 from 172 days in March 2026.

items.statement: H1 FY2027 operating cash flow rose to INR 350 crore from INR 39.8 crore a year earlier.
items.quote: Our cash flow from operation was at INR 350 crore, a positive number in H1 FY 2027 compared with INR 39.8 crore in H1 FY 2026.

items.statement: Management expects the second half of FY2027 to be stronger than the first, backed by the order book.
items.quote: We expect this momentum to continue into the second half of the fiscal year, with H2 of FY 2027 anticipated to be stronger than H1, supported by our robust order book

items.quote: We have given certain guidance, initially at 80% revenue growth and 24% EBITDA margin.

items.statement: Working capital is expected to be about 100 days by the end of FY2027.
items.quote: By end of FY 2027, we expect to maintain working capital at around 100 days.

items.statement: ROCE is expected to rise to about 23% by the end of FY2027 from 17.2% in FY2026.
items.quote: ROCE is expected to improve to around 23% by end of FY 2027 from 17.2% in FY 2026.

items.statement: MNC aerospace demand is robust, with volumes of qualified products ramping up significantly.
items.quote: Our MNC aerospace business continues to witness a robust demand with products that have already been qualified, seeing a significant ramp-up in volumes.

items.statement: Fuel cell demand is far higher than expected and orders are substantial.
items.quote: I mean, we are receiving substantial orders, and the demand is a lot more than what we can expect.

items.statement: EBITDA margin rose to 24.4%, helped by higher revenue, a better mix and operating leverage.
items.quote: EBITDA margin was 24.4% compared to 12.5% in Q2 FY 2026 and 23.6% in Q1 FY 2027. This improvement came from a higher revenue, a better mix, and operating leverage.

items.statement: Management expects further margin improvement but will not change guidance mid-year.
items.quote: No, we will definitely have improvement. As I said, we don't want to change our guidance in the middle of the year, quarter-on-quarter basis.

items.statement: Some consumables costs have risen because of the current geopolitical situation.
items.quote: Yes, there are certain cost increases in terms of certain consumables which we have looked into because of the current geopolitical situation

items.statement: Total planned capex is about INR 500 crore: INR 350 crore for fuel cells and INR 150 crore for other verticals.
items.quote: Actually, our total CapEx planned is in the company around INR 500 crore, of which INR 350 crore for the fuel cells business and remaining INR 150 crore for other sectors

items.statement: Of the INR 500 crore capex, INR 100 crore fell in FY2026 and INR 400 crore falls in FY2027.
items.quote: INR 500 crore will be, INR 100 crore is FY 2026, INR 400 crore will be FY 2027.

items.statement: Phase II fuel cell capacity expansion is nearly complete and should be operational by end of November.
items.quote: Our phase II capacity expansion is nearing completion, with the facility expected to be operational by end of November.

items.statement: Phase III will multiply manufacturing capacity in a new facility, with completion expected by June 2028.
items.quote: Phase III, which will enhance our manufacturing capacity manifold, will be housed in a new dedicated facility, with the overall expansion expected to be completed by June 2028.

items.statement: Phase II is a smaller expansion that adds about 30% to existing capacity.
items.quote: See, the phase II capacity, as I said, it is a smaller expansion. It is about 30% higher than our existing capacity.

items.statement: H1 FY2027 order inflow was a record INR 4,102 crore.
items.quote: We have witnessed a record order inflows of INR 4,102 crore during H1 FY 2027, reflecting robust demand across our business segments.

items.statement: Management expects order momentum to continue and a strong closing order book at end of FY2027.
items.quote: we expect to sustain this momentum in the coming quarters and anticipate a strong closing order book by the end of FY 2027.

items.statement: Total debt is about INR 465 crore, split into INR 189 crore long-term and INR 276 crore short-term.
items.quote: Our total debt is around INR 465 crore, of which INR 189 crore is a long-term debt and INR 276 crore is a short-term debt.

items.statement: Net of investments, debt is about INR 107 crore.
items.quote: It literally means we have around INR 107 crore debt after adjusting the investments.

items.statement: The data center business could scale to INR 350-450 crore over two years once first articles are qualified.
items.quote: We have a significant potential for scalability following the successful completion and qualification of these first articles, with the business having the potential to scale up to INR 350 crore-INR 450 crore over the next two years.

items.statement: The company has started exporting ball screws, which it calls a significant milestone.
items.quote: I am also glad to share that we have commenced exports of ball screws as well, marking a significant milestone for the company.

items.statement: The oil and gas facility should be operational by end November, and first-article qualification with Weatherford is complete.
items.quote: our dedicated manufacturing facility is expected to become operational by end November, while the development and first articles qualification has already been completed with Weatherford

items.quote: we now see significant opportunities emerging as Government of India targets to achieve 100 GW of nuclear power capacity by 2047.

items.quote: No, this is all unwanted speculation, but we are growing in different segments, as you have seen very clearly. We are not just depending on one segment as such.
